description_en: Changes the status of a quota template. By default, the quota template is not configured. If the management account of a resource directory uses a quota template for the first time, you must enable the quota template. Only the management account of a resource directory can change the status of quota templates
description_zh: 配额模板的默认状态为未设置。当资源目录的管理账号初次使用配额模板时，需要开启配额模板。只有资源目录的管理员账号可修改配额模版
name: ModifyQuotaTemplateServiceStatus

parameters.help_en:
The status of the quota template. Valid values:

-1: The quota template is disabled.

1: The quota template is enabled
parameters.help_zh:
配额模板的状态。取值：

-1：禁用。
1：开启
parameters.name: service_status
